finalDocumentInspection.stdin:
import json
from pathlib import Path
status_path=Path('artifacts/production-workspace-implementation/native-status/NativeHarness.json')
status=json.loads(status_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
results=[]
for name in status['files']:
    p=Path(name)
    if name.startswith('.claude/'):
        current=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('---',2)[1]
        released=(Path('harness/versions/1.5.0')/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('---',2)[1]
        results.append({'file':name,'frontmatterUnchanged':current==released})
print(json.dumps({'statusJsonValid':True,'listedFilesExisting':sum(Path(name).is_file() for name in status['files']),'frontmatters':results,'orchestratorUnder500Lines':len(Path('.claude/skills/production-orchestrator/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines())<500},indent=2))
